Description: "Normalize pre-order flags in handlePrint so that completed pre-orders are correctly identified as settled invoices."
ReplacementContent: "    // Check if it's a pre-order (POS Order has pre_order_id, DB object has advance_paid)\n    const isPreOrder = !!(order.pre_order_id || order.advance_paid !== undefined);"
TargetContent: "    // Check if it's a pre-order (POS Order has pre_order_id, DB object has advance_paid and status != 'COMPLETED')\n    const isPreOrder = !!(order.pre_order_id || (order.advance_paid !== undefined && order.status !== 'COMPLETED'));"
